text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about that!
Asking you for cooking lessons out of the blue.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm just really happy you're
interested in French cuisine, Hishiama-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for going out of your way
to rent a rental kitchen!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! It's a rare opportunity, so
I really want to sit down and learn properly!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's the spirit!
All right, I'll do my best too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we rented a kitchen and "Sakura Laurel's
French Cooking Class" officially began!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Alright, today we're making "Terrine."
First, let's prep the veggies.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Peel the bell peppers... and since the tomatoes
are going in the blender, precision doesn't matter!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: All right, let's crunch right in!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Right, right!
As expected of Hishi Ama-chan, you're a natural♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after that, the cooking class
went on smoothly, but—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Mm, about like this?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Pour the sauce out of the blender and through the strainer...
Yes, yes, you're doing great!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps as she was teaching, she forgot that Hishi Amazon was her classmate—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That should do for the veggies. Now, if I pour the bouillon into the mold...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Right, right! That's amazing~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The way they treated me gradually started
feeling like how one treats a younger junior...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heheh, how about it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yup, it's super delicious!
Well done~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
choice_data_list: I'll watch over you just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm sorry!
I got carried away while teaching you...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
No, it's fine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I take after my mom with this personality, but
I'm actually the youngest child.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I did something right, my older brothers and sisters
used to praise me just like you do.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: “I see... Fufu, so Hishiama-chan had memories like that too!”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm an only child, but back at my old
club, there were so many girls who felt like little sisters to me...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I'm teaching something,
I have a habit of acting like a big sister."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Isn't that great! They had so many compliments about the way you teach, it made me feel so good!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, is that so?
...In that case, should I praise you even more?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? No, I mean, of course—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, just kidding♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: From that day on, the two of them were often seen chatting together over open cookbooks.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoops, my bad.
I'll go grab some plates!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
......
Even though we're classmates, I went and patted her head.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha, that won't do! Whenever I teach,
it just becomes a habit... I need to be careful!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I wonder why. Even though Hishiama-chan
is so dependable and everything.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"When you patted my head
and smiled bashfully at me—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It made me remember my juniors
back at Victory Club.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I learned that Hishi Amazon
was actually the youngest child in her family.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: She acts like such a big sister, so it's quite surprising!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, but considering that reaction...
Hehe, maybe not?
